title: Member Privacy Settings and Hiding Phone Numbers

sections.heading: Protecting Member Contact Details
sections.content:
Directory administrators can restrict visibility of member phone numbers, email addresses, and physical addresses to logged-in members or premium subscribers only.
1. Go to Finance > Membership Plans.
2. Click 'Edit' next to the desired plan.
3. Open the 'Search Visibility' tab.
4. Locate 'Show Phone Number on Public Search Results'.
5. Set toggle to 'Only Logged-in Members' or 'Hide Completely'.
6. Click 'Save Changes'.

procedural_steps: Click Edit on the membership plan
Set 'Show Phone Number' toggle to desired privacy setting
full_text:
Protecting Member Contact Details
Directory administrators can restrict visibility of member phone numbers, email addresses, and physical addresses to logged-in members or premium subscribers only.
1. Go to Finance > Membership Plans.
2. Click 'Edit' next to the desired plan.
3. Open the 'Search Visibility' tab.
4. Locate 'Show Phone Number on Public Search Results'.
5. Set toggle to 'Only Logged-in Members' or 'Hide Completely'.
6. Click 'Save Changes'.
